name: mux-factory-board-app
description: The board app: an Electron window that runs the Mux factory board, copied from T3 Code's desktop app.

scripts.dev: pnpm --dir ../board run build && vp pack && node scripts/start-electron.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm --dir ../board run build && vp pack && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.test: pnpm --dir ../board run build && vp test run
